title: epan: Use unsigned for offset variables in packet-[c-e]* dissectors
description:
Change local offset variables and static helper function parameters
from int to unsigned across dissectors C to E.

Ping #20103

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • cbb767c9 - epan: Use unsigned for offset variables in packet-[c-e]* dissectors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/25430/diffs?diff_id=1855928411&start_sha=35bc96082e8b454b1a5fcfd594a5e1e51e30b360)

I haven't looked at this closely, but you do need to be careful about signed length fields.  Sometimes they get decremented and exit a loop when they get \< 0, which will obviously never happen for an unsigned.

Okej, I havn't I seen any `length` that got decremented but you are probably correct, however in this instance and similar it's okej since it used to only to store `length = tvb_reported_length(tvb);`
